deps.edn.reason: The git floors on error, bytes, edn, test and text, and the git pins on org-nist-sha2 and org-ietf-x25519, point at repositories that are bundled here as kotoba.error, kotoba.bytes, kotoba.edn, kotoba.test, kotoba.text, gov.nist.sha2 and org.ietf.x25519; they become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The comment above :deps and the :aliases section are unchanged.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the source and test paths.
